ps.en: When a [[journalist]] named Chen began keeping a [[journal]] of every case she covered, she never imagined the [[journey]] would keep her in one courtroom for three years.
ps.zh: 一位名叫陈的记者，开始为自己报道的每一起案件写日志。她从未想过，这段旅程会让她在同一间法庭里待上三年。

ps.en: The case concerned a small factory and the families who had brought a [[lawsuit]] against it. The [[judge]] who heard it was known for her calm [[judgment]]; the [[jury]] trusted her, and so did the public. Yet the dispute crossed more than one [[jurisdiction]], and the [[judicial]] process slowed to a crawl.
ps.zh: 案件涉及的是一家小工厂，以及那些对它提起诉讼的家庭。审理此案的法官以沉着冷静的判断力著称；陪审团信任她，公众也是。然而这起纠纷跨越了不止一个司法管辖区，司法程序慢得像蜗牛爬。

ps.en: Chen refused to [[label]] the workers as victims or the owners as villains — the [[latter]] were not monsters, only careless. What she wanted was not sympathy but [[justice]], and she believed honest reporting could [[justify]] the long wait. Three years later, when the [[law]] finally gave its answer, Chen wrote a single line: the truth takes time.
ps.zh: 陈拒绝把工人简单贴上「受害者」的标签，也不把厂主写成恶人——后者并非魔鬼，只是疏忽。她要的不是同情，而是公正；她相信诚实的报道能让漫长的等待变得正当。三年后，当法律终于给出答案，陈只写了一行字：真相需要时间。

ps.en: Professor Wei had one [[obsession]]: to [[observe]] people without judging them. Her [[objective]] was modest — to record how strangers behave in a crowded station — but her method was not.
ps.zh: 魏教授只有一个执念：不带评判地观察人。她的目标很朴素——记录陌生人在拥挤车站里的行为——但她的方法并不朴素。

ps.en: She would sit for hours, notebook open, and turn every [[observation]] into data. Colleagues raised an [[objection]]: such research was too [[obscure]], too small to matter. Some even called her methods [[obsolete]], as if hand-written notes belonged to another century.
ps.zh: 她会一坐几个小时，摊开笔记本，把每一次观察都变成数据。同事提出异议：这样的研究太冷门了，太微小了，不值一提。有人甚至说她的方法已经过时，仿佛手写笔记属于上个世纪。

ps.en: Wei did not [[object]]; she had no [[obligation]] to defend her habits, only to [[obtain]] what others missed. What she found was [[obvious]] in the end: people are kinder than any [[ideal]] or [[ideology]] predicts. No theory [[obliged|oblige]] her to keep going — only the quiet pleasure of watching. Her book, when it appeared, contained not a single statistic.
ps.zh: 魏并不反对；她没有义务为自己的习惯辩护，只想获得别人错过的东西。她最终发现的东西显而易见：人比任何理想或意识形态所预言的都要善良。没有任何理论迫使她继续下去——只有那种静静观看的乐趣。她的书出版时，里面没有一个统计数据。

ps.en: At eighty, Grandma Rong still had a [[radiant]] smile. Photographers said she seemed to [[radiate]] warmth, and none of them could guess that she had once been a [[radical]] student.
ps.zh: 八十岁的容奶奶笑起来依然容光焕发。摄影师们说她仿佛在散发着温暖，谁也猜不到她曾经是个激进的学生。

ps.en: When a museum tried to [[identify]] the young woman in an old photograph, the whole family argued about who she was. For decades she had carried no papers, and [[identification]] meant little to a woman who had outlived three of them. Her daughter insisted the portrait was [[identical]] to one taken in 1965; her son doubted it.
ps.zh: 当博物馆试图辨认一张旧照片里的年轻女子时，全家人争论起她到底是谁。几十年来她身上不带任何证件，而对一个已经活过了三代证件的人来说，身份证明没什么意义。女儿坚称那张肖像与 1965 年拍的一张一模一样，儿子却存疑。

ps.en: Yet the [[magnitude]] of the question was not historical but personal — who are you when every record is gone? Grandma Rong [[maintained|maintain]] that her [[identity]] was not in any archive. Her days, she said, were simply the [[maintenance]] of small rituals: tea at seven, a walk at dusk. The photograph was [[magnified|magnify]] on a [[magnificent]] screen at the exhibition, and thousands of strangers looked at a face with no name.
ps.zh: 然而这个问题的重要性不在历史，而在个人——当所有记录都消失了，你是谁？容奶奶坚持认为，她的身份不在任何档案里。她说，她的日子不过是些小小仪式的维持：七点喝茶，黄昏散步。展览上，那张照片被放大在宏伟的屏幕上，成千上万的陌生人，看着一张没有名字的脸。

ps.en: Dr. Han's lecture had one [[theme]]: that a [[theory]] is only as good as the people it helps. She had studied psychology as her [[major]], and the [[majority]] of her patients came to her not for [[therapy]] but for permission to rest.
ps.zh: 韩博士的讲座只有一个主题：理论的好坏，取决于它帮到了多少人。她主修心理学，来找她的多数病人不是为了治疗，而是为了获准休息。

ps.en: Her [[qualifications|qualification]] were impressive, yet she admitted that most of her skill came from listening, not from books. Students who hoped to [[qualify]] as counsellors often asked her for a formula; she offered none.
ps.zh: 她的资历很亮眼，但她承认自己大部分的本事来自倾听，而非书本。想取得心理咨询师资格的学生常来向她要一套公式；她一套也不给。

ps.en: Pure [[theoretical]] knowledge, she warned, can [[lag]] behind real life by a decade. Progress, she said, is [[largely]] [[lateral]] — not a straight climb but a series of sideways steps. And the [[quality]] of a conversation, she added, is what [[makes|make]] a career worth having.
ps.zh: 她提醒说，纯粹的理论知识可能落后于现实十年之久。她说，进步多半是横向的——不是笔直向上爬，而是一连串横着迈的步子。她还说，一场对话的质量，才让一份职业值得拥有。

c: an investigative journalist 调查记者
a seasoned journalist 资深记者
words.dif: journalist 泛指记者；reporter 多指跑现场的采访记者；editor 是编辑，不是记者
words.pat: Journalists are expected to report facts rather than feelings.
words.patZh: 记者理应报道事实，而非情绪。

c: a medical / learned journal 医学、学术期刊
words.dif: journal 既可指「期刊」也可指「日志」；diary 只指私人日记
words.pat: The study was published in a leading medical journal.
words.patZh: 该研究发表于一家顶级医学期刊。

c: set out on a journey 启程
a journey of discovery 探索之旅
words.dif: journey 多指长途或心路历程；trip 是短途往返；voyage 专指海上航行
words.pat: Success is a journey rather than a destination.
words.patZh: 成功是一段旅程，而非终点。

c: bring / file a lawsuit against sb 对…提起诉讼
face a lawsuit 面临诉讼
words.dif: lawsuit 指民事诉讼；charge 是刑事指控；sue 是动词
words.pat: The company is now facing a lawsuit over its data practices.
words.patZh: 该公司正因数据做法面临诉讼。

words.exam: 法官；审判员；评判员；判决；判断
c: judge sb / sth by 以…来判断
judge a competition 担任评委
words.dif: judge 兼「法官」与「评判」；justify 是「证明正当」，两者不要混
words.pat: Don't judge a person by his appearance.
words.patZh: 不要以貌取人。

c: pass judgment on 对…作出评判
in one's judgment 依某人看
a sound judgment 明智的判断
words.dif: judgment 是判断或判决；verdict 是陪审团裁决；sentence 是量刑
words.pat: In my judgment, the policy does more harm than good.
words.patZh: 依我看，这项政策弊大于利。

c: serve on a jury 担任陪审员
words.dif: jury 是「陪审团（集体）」；juror 是「陪审员（个人）」
words.pat: The jury reached a verdict after two days of discussion.
words.patZh: 陪审团讨论两天后作出裁决。

words.exam: 司法权；管辖权；管辖区域
c: fall within / outside the jurisdiction of
have jurisdiction over 对…有管辖权
words.dif: jurisdiction 强调「权限与辖区」；authority 强调「权力」本身
words.pat: This case falls outside the jurisdiction of the local court.
words.patZh: 本案不属当地法院管辖。

words.exam: 法庭的，司法的，审判的；公正的
c: the judicial system 司法体系
words.dif: judicial 是「司法的」；legal 是「合法的」；just 是「公正的」
words.pat: Judicial independence is essential to a fair society.
words.patZh: 司法独立是公平社会的基石。

c: label sb / sth as 把…称为
a warning label 警示标签
words.dif: label 侧重「归类、扣帽子」；tag 是「系上标签」；brand 侧重「打上品牌烙印」
words.pat: We should not label children simply by their test scores.
words.patZh: 我们不该用考试分数给孩子贴标签。

c: the former... the latter... 前者…后者…
in the latter half of the year 下半年
words.dif: latter 指「两者中的后者」；last 指「最后一个」；latest 指「最新的」
words.pat: Of the two options, the latter seems more practical.
words.patZh: 两个方案中，后者更可行。

c: bring sb to justice 将…绳之以法
do justice to 公正对待
fam: just adj. → justice n. → justify v. → justification n.
words.dif: justice 是「公正、司法」；justify 是「证明正当」；just 是形容词
words.pat: True justice means treating every citizen alike.
words.patZh: 真正的公正是一视同仁地对待每个公民。

c: be justified in doing sth 做…是有道理的
words.dif: justify 是「证明有理」；excuse 是「原谅、找借口」
words.pat: The end does not justify the means.
words.patZh: 目的不能使手段正当。

c: the law of nature 自然规律
words.dif: law 泛指法律；regulation 是具体法规细则；rule 只是规则
words.pat: The new law is designed to protect consumer rights.
words.patZh: 新法旨在保护消费者权益。

c: an obsession with sth 对…的执念
fam: obsess v. → obsessed adj. → obsessive adj. 过度的
words.dif: obsession 是名词（执念）；obsessed 是形容词（着迷的），词性常混
words.pat: Modern society has an unhealthy obsession with speed.
words.patZh: 现代社会对速度有一种病态的执念。

words.exam: 观察；注意到；遵守；说话，评论
c: observe the rules / law 遵守规则
words.dif: 三个义项都考过，「遵守」这一层最容易漏，阅读里常作此义
words.pat: One may observe that attitudes have changed greatly in a decade.
words.patZh: 可以注意到，十年间观念已大不相同。

c: achieve / meet an objective 达成目标
fam: object n./v. → objective → objectivity n. 客观性
words.dif: objective 是「客观的」（反义 subjective）；object 是「物体 / 反对」
words.pat: Our primary objective is to reduce costs without cutting quality.
words.patZh: 我们的首要目标是在不牺牲质量的前提下降低成本。

words.dif: observation 是「观察 / 言论」；observance 是「遵守」，拼写差一个字母
words.pat: His observation that talent needs discipline still holds true.
words.patZh: 他那个「天赋需要纪律」的判断至今成立。

c: raise an objection to 对…提出异议
have no objection to doing 不反对做…
fam: object v. → objection → objectionable adj. 令人反感的
words.dif: objection 是可数的「一条异议」；opposition 偏抽象、不可数
words.pat: I have no objection to your plan, provided the budget is clear.
words.patZh: 只要预算清楚，我不反对你的方案。

words.exam: 费解的；无名的；遮蔽；使变模糊
c: obscure the truth 掩盖真相
words.dif: obscure 强调「不为人知 / 难懂」；vague 强调「含糊、说不清」，两者常一起设选项
words.pat: Advances in science are often made by obscure researchers.
words.patZh: 科学的进步往往由默默无闻的研究者推动。

fam: obsolescence n.（planned obsolescence 计划性淘汰）
words.dif: obsolete 是「已被淘汰」；old-fashioned 只是「老派」；ancient 是「古老」
words.pat: Skills learned today may become obsolete within a decade.
words.patZh: 今天学到的技能，十年内就可能被淘汰。

c: object to doing sth 反对做…
words.dif: object to 后面必须接动名词；表达「反对说…」才用 object that 从句
words.pat: Many residents objected to the plan on environmental grounds.
words.patZh: 许多居民以环保为由反对该方案。

c: meet / fulfil an obligation 履行义务
fam: oblige v. → obligation → obligatory adj. 强制的
words.dif: obligation 强调「外部约束下的义务」；duty 强调「职责本分」
words.pat: Employers have an obligation to provide a safe workplace.
words.patZh: 雇主有义务提供安全的工作场所。

words.exam: 强迫，迫使；施恩惠于；使感激
c: oblige sb to do sth 迫使…做…
be obliged to do 不得不做
be much obliged to sb 非常感激某人
words.dif: oblige 最常以被动 be obliged to 出现；force 语气更强硬
words.pat: Rising costs obliged the firm to cut its workforce.
words.patZh: 成本上升迫使该公司裁员。

words.dif: obtain 得到「具体的东西」；attain 达到「目标 / 水平」；gain 侧重「努力得来」
words.pat: It is difficult to obtain reliable data on this subject.
words.patZh: 很难获得关于这一课题的可靠数据。

words.exam: 明显的，显而易见的；平淡无奇的
c: for obvious reasons 出于显而易见的原因
words.dif: obvious 是一眼可见；evident 有证据支撑；apparent 是「表面看来」
words.pat: It is obvious that no single solution fits every case.
words.patZh: 显然，没有一个方案适用于所有情况。

words.exam: 理想的，完美的；空想的；理想
c: be ideal for 非常适合
in an ideal world 在理想情况下
words.dif: ideal 是「完美的 / 理想」；ideology 是「意识形态」，语义完全不同
words.pat: In an ideal world, everyone would have equal access to education.
words.patZh: 在理想的世界里，人人都能平等受教育。

words.exam: 思想意识，观念形态，思想体系
c: dominant ideology 主流意识形态
words.dif: ideology 是「成体系的观念」；idea 只是「一个想法」，考试常拿两者对比
words.pat: Advertising sells not only products but also a quiet ideology.
words.patZh: 广告卖的不只是产品，还有一套隐形的观念。

words.exam: 发光的，辐射的；容光焕发的
c: a radiant smile 灿烂的笑容
radiant with joy 喜形于色
fam: radiate v. → radiation n. 辐射 → radiator n. 散热器
words.dif: radiant 强调「发光、容光焕发」；bright 只指「亮度高」
words.pat: She looked radiant in the old photograph, unaware of what was to come.
words.patZh: 照片里的她容光焕发，尚不知往后将经历什么。

c: radiate heat / warmth 散发热量
radiate from 从…呈辐射状散开
words.dif: radiate 是动词（发散）；radiant 是形容词（发光的），一字之差
words.pat: Warmth radiated from the old house long after sunset.
words.patZh: 日落后很久，那栋老屋仍散发着暖意。

words.exam: 根本的，基本的；彻底的；激进的；激进分子
c: a radical change 彻底的改变
words.dif: radical 强调「根本的、彻底的」；extreme 强调「极端的」，贬义更重
words.pat: Cutting carbon emissions requires radical changes in how we work.
words.patZh: 减排要求我们彻底改变工作方式。

c: identify sb / sth as 认定…为
identify with 认同，与…产生共鸣
be identified with 与…密切相关
words.dif: identify 是动词；identity 是名词（身份）；identical 是形容词（相同的）
words.pat: Readers identify with characters who share their own doubts.
words.patZh: 读者会认同那些与自己有同样困惑的角色。

words.exam: 识别，鉴别，确认；身份证明
c: carry / show identification 出示证件
words.dif: identification 是「证件」或「识别过程」；identity 是「身份本身」
words.pat: The identification of the cause took months of careful work.
words.patZh: 查明原因花了数月细致的工夫。

words.exam: 完全相同的，一模一样的
c: be identical to / with 与…完全相同
words.dif: identical 是「完全相同」；similar 只是「相似」，考试常互为干扰项
words.pat: No two people respond to the same treatment in an identical way.
words.patZh: 没有人对同一种治疗的反应是完全一样的。

words.exam: 巨大，广大；重大，重要性；震级
c: the magnitude of the problem 问题的严重程度
of this magnitude 如此规模的
the magnitude of an earthquake 震级
words.dif: magnitude 常指「问题 / 事件的规模与严重性」；size 只指物理大小
words.pat: Few people understood the magnitude of the crisis at the time.
words.patZh: 当时很少有人明白这场危机有多严重。

words.exam: 维持，保持；维修，保养；赡养；坚持，主张
c: maintain one's innocence 坚称自己无罪
maintain a car 保养汽车
words.dif: maintain 后可直接接宾语从句表「主张」，keep 没有这个用法
words.pat: The company maintains that its products are entirely safe.
words.patZh: 该公司坚称其产品完全安全。

words.exam: 相同性，一致；本身，本体；身份
c: a sense of identity 身份认同感
conceal one's identity 隐瞒身份
words.dif: identity 是「身份（本身）」；identification 常指「证件 / 识别动作」
words.pat: Language is closely tied to cultural identity.
words.patZh: 语言与文化身份紧密相连。

words.exam: 维持，保持；维修，保养；生活费
words.dif: 拼写陷阱：mainten-ance，词根 ten 不写成 tain，很多人误写 maintenance
words.pat: Regular maintenance is far cheaper than repair.
words.patZh: 定期保养远比事后修理便宜。

c: magnify sth by ... times 把…放大…倍
magnify the problem 夸大问题
words.dif: magnify 强调「放大使其显得更大」；enlarge 只是「使尺寸变大」
words.pat: Media coverage can magnify a minor incident into a national debate.
words.patZh: 媒体报道能把一桩小事放大成全国性争论。

words.dif: magnificent 强调「壮丽华美」；grand 强调「宏大、气派」
words.pat: The exhibition hall itself was as magnificent as the works inside it.
words.patZh: 展厅本身和其中的展品一样壮丽。

words.dif: theme 是「贯穿全文的中心思想」；topic 只是「谈论的话题」，浅一层
words.pat: A common theme in his work is the cost of ambition.
words.patZh: 他作品中一个常见的主题是野心的代价。

words.exam: 理论，原理；学说，见解，看法
c: put forward a theory 提出理论
words.dif: theory 是成体系的「理论」；hypothesis 是待验证的「假说」
words.pat: In theory the system is fair; in practice it is not.
words.patZh: 这套制度理论上公平，实践中并非如此。

words.exam: 较大的，较重要的；专业，主修科；主修，专攻
c: play a major role 起主要作用
words.dif: 作动词必须接 in（major in English）；作形容词时不接 in，考试常设这个陷阱
words.pat: Technology plays a major role in shaping modern education.
words.patZh: 技术在塑造现代教育中起主要作用。

words.exam: 多数，大多数；法定年龄，成年
words.dif: the majority of 后接复数名词，谓语可单可复；a majority of 更强调票数过半
words.pat: The majority of consumers now shop online at least once a month.
words.patZh: 如今大多数消费者每月至少网购一次。

c: undergo / receive therapy 接受治疗
words.dif: therapy 侧重「疗程、疗法」；treatment 指具体的「治疗手段」
words.pat: For many people, talking is the most effective therapy of all.
words.patZh: 对许多人来说，倾诉本身就是最有效的疗法。

words.exam: 资格，合格；限定，限制性条件；合格证
c: meet the qualifications for 符合…的条件
words.dif: qualification 是「资格、证书」；ability 是「能力」本身，招聘语境常并列出现
words.pat: Employers increasingly value experience over formal qualifications.
words.patZh: 雇主越来越看重经验，而非正式学历。

words.exam: 使具有资格，证明合格；限制，限定；修饰
words.dif: qualify for 后接「机会、资格」；qualify as 后接「身份」
words.pat: Learning a second language can qualify you for better-paid work.
words.patZh: 学一门外语能让你有资格拿到更高薪的工作。

c: a theoretical framework 理论框架
words.dif: theoretical 与 practical 是一对，考研常把「理论与实践的落差」作为论点
words.pat: Theoretical knowledge means little unless it is tested in practice.
words.patZh: 理论知识若不经实践检验，便意义不大。

c: lag far behind 远远落后
words.dif: lag behind 强调「落后于对手或进度」；delay 强调「推迟、延误」
words.pat: Wages have lagged behind the cost of living for a decade.
words.patZh: 十年来工资一直落后于生活成本。

words.exam: 大量地，大规模地；主要地，基本上
c: largely due to 主要由于
largely unnoticed 基本无人注意
words.dif: largely 表「在很大程度上」；mostly 表「大多数情况下」，两者常同框设选项
words.pat: The decline in sales was largely due to rising prices.
words.patZh: 销量下滑主要源于价格上涨。

c: a lateral move 平级调动
words.dif: lateral 是「横向的」，与 vertical（纵向的）成对，写作里对比好用
words.pat: Lateral thinking sometimes solves problems that logic cannot.
words.patZh: 横向思维有时能解决逻辑解不了的问题。

words.exam: 质量，品级；性质，特性；品德，品质；优质
c: the quality of life 生活质量
fam: qualify / qualification / qualitative adj. 定性的
words.dif: 单数 quality 指「质量」；复数 qualities 指「品德、特质」，考试常按这个区分出题
words.pat: What matters most is not the quantity of information but its quality.
words.patZh: 最重要的不是信息量，而是信息质量。

words.exam: 做，制造；构成；强迫，迫使；走过（一段距离）；促成，成就
c: be made up of 由…构成
words.dif: 主动结构 make sb do 不带 to；被动结构 be made to do 必须带 to，这是高频考点
words.pat: What makes a career worth having is rarely the salary.
words.patZh: 让一份职业值得拥有的，很少是薪水。
